Body.Content:
Visual Studio 2026 is the next evolution of the world’s most trusted IDE—modernized with AI deeply integrated into everyday workflows. By seamlessly integrating GitHub Copilot and agentic workflows, Visual Studio empowers professional developers to move faster, reduce toil, and deliver higher-quality software. Combined with modern UX, blazing performance, and enterprise-grade trust, Visual Studio remains the IDE of choice for complex, mission-critical development. 

Learn more.
